name: page-header
description: Page opening band: breadcrumb + title + subtitle. The composition equivalent of the retired layout/page-header block — a background is asked for by wrapping it in a section (lesson 023: no invisible background default).
provenPattern: Converted from a block to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'.

knowledge.purpose: The opening band of every page other than the home page
useCases: Greeting header: a personal salutation + the day's summary (former greeting-header)
antiPatterns: Zemini pattern icine gommek — zemin section kararidir

mobileCollapse: Single column; title and subtitle stacked — no change.
